protocol.hypothesis: M6 full joint normal PCA remains the confirmed reference. Several deterministic projection alternatives and downstream experts failed the joint gate. Test diversity of normal-reference geometry across seed heads through Bayesian-bootstrap weighting of fit-normal patient centers.
protocol.geometry: Only fit-normal patient centroids after original normalization and within-image region averaging. Draw positive Dirichlet weights on sorted fit-normal patients. Shared mode reuses one weight vector across four streams; independent mode draws four vectors. Compute weighted-center covariance with correction 1/(1-sum(weights^2)); estimate supported leading32 axes. The projection anchor remains the uniform normal patient mean, matching M6. Refit and redraw geometry separately per phase and model seed.
protocol.rng: Private NumPy RNG seed=20281924+100*phase_index+model_seed, phase_index validation0/fold0=1/fold1=2/fold2=3. Geometry sampling must consume no global Torch/MLP RNG. Freeze exact patient lists, drawn weights and geometry hashes before each actual head fit.
protocol.architecture: Original normal-suppressed M5 head with seed-dependent fixed geometry. Original full task, hyperparameters and patient weights unchanged. Four architectures48newMLPheads; each additionally scored with fixed .75 new-branch/.25 original M5 mixture, eight scores without extra fusion fits.
protocol.geometry_freeze: Compute all48 arm/phase/seed geometries before any head fitting; save exact normal patient weights, lists, arrays and SHA256 provenance. Private NumPy RNG leaves original MLP initialization unchanged.
protocol.selection: Freeze one highest passing original CV candidate before previously unused patient-partition confirmation against M6/M5/fixed Gaussian. No automatic external scoring.
protocol.audit: Uniform-weight control reproduces M6; independent patient loops/Gram spectra, private RNG, patient duplication invariance and four real256-image full-task gradient/update/recovery checks. Restore all48 actual selected checkpoints and all stopping/outer probabilities with independent NumPy projection plus plain M5. Check complete patient coverage, exact frozen geometry buffers and16fixed fusion phases.
protocol.external_test_policy: Only development rows0:2091; external feature arrays set NaN before fitting. No external outcomes or prediction files loaded for research selection.
